<issue>
[Bug]: ToolChoice.None 被映射为 Anthropic any
AnthropicToolsHelper 把 ToolChoice.None 映射成 any，会强制工具调用，和“禁用工具”语义相反。

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, find AnthropicToolsHelper and show the code (with line numbers and file path) that maps ToolChoice to Anthropic tool_choice, especially ToolChoice.None.

content.content: {"summary":"AnthropicToolsHelper is at agentscope-extensions/agentscope-extensions-model/agentscope-extensions-model-anthropic/src/main/java/io/agentscope/extensions/model/anthropic/formatter/AnthropicToolsHelper.java (under /testbed). Its private applyToolChoice method maps ToolChoice to Anthropic tool_choice. ToolChoice.None is not given its own Anthropic value: it is mapped to 'any', the same as Required, so the model is forced to call a tool rather than being prevented from calling one. This looks like a semantic mismatch worth flagging.","findings":["AnthropicToolsHelper.java:91-110 (applyToolChoice): Auto -> ofAuto(ToolChoiceAuto) (line 93-94).","AnthropicToolsHelper.java:95-97: ToolChoice.None -> ofAny(ToolChoiceAny.builder().build()), with the comment \"Anthropic doesn't have None, use Any instead\". This forces tool use, which is the opposite of 'disable tool calling' (docs/v1/en/docs/task/model.md:434 describes None as 'Disable tool calling').","AnthropicToolsHelper.java:98-104: ToolChoice.Required -> ofAny(...) as well, with a log.warn saying Anthropic doesn't support Required directly, so None and Required produce the same request.","AnthropicToolsHelper.java:105-106: ToolChoice.Specific -> ofTool(ToolChoiceTool.name(specific.toolName())).","AnthropicToolsHelper.java:107-109: unknown types log a warning and set nothing.","AnthropicToolsHelper.java:71-73 (applyTools): applyToolChoice is only called when tools are non-empty (early return at lines 54-56) and options.getToolChoice() is non-null, so with no tools no tool_choice is sent at all.","No ToolChoice.None case that omits tool_choice exists; Anthropic's API has no 'none' value in this helper's mapping."],"confidence":0.9}

input.instruction: Check whether the anthropic-java SDK jar used by /testbed (look in ~/.m2 or gradle caches) contains class com.anthropic.models.messages.ToolChoiceNone and ToolChoice.ofNone. Report yes/no.

content.content: {"summary":"The anthropic-java SDK used by /testbed is version 2.14.0 (dependency declared as 'anthropic-java' in the build files). The jar anthropic-java-core-2.14.0.jar in ~/.m2 contains class com/anthropic/models/messages/ToolChoiceNone.class, and the ToolChoice.class in that jar contains the method name 'ofNone'. Both checks pass. The anthropic-java-2.14.0.jar and okhttp client jars do not contain these classes, but they are not where the model classes live.","findings":["Jar: /root/.m2/repository/com/anthropic/anthropic-java-core/2.14.0/anthropic-java-core-2.14.0.jar contains com/anthropic/models/messages/ToolChoiceNone.class","Same jar: com/anthropic/models/messages/ToolChoice.class contains the string 'ofNone' (factory method present)","Only version found in ~/.m2 or ~/.gradle is 2.14.0; /testbed build files reference the 'anthropic-java' artifact"],"confidence":0.9}
